lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the Telluride Hospital District board meeting Wednesday, where directors are expected to act on a Two Site Model for the new facility and take up a Letter of Intent — decisions that will shape what gets built and where for decades. Mountain Village's HOA board also meets that day to form a Workforce Housing Committee and vote on updated policies. And Tuesday, Town Council sits down for a serious look at Comprehensive Plan goals, a gondola subcommittee update, and proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies.

notable.stake: Board may act on Two Site Model and LOI, shaping the new hospital's scale and location.
TMVOA votes to form Workforce Housing Committee and adopt updated policies.
Council reviews Comprehensive Plan goals and third-party audit of town rental housing policies.
